html: Segment content is a wrapper element used to control the display of child elements when using swipeable segments. Segment content elements are children of a single segment view instance that is linked to a segment. Refer to our swipeable segments documentation for more information on how to use segment contents.
Each ion-segment-content needs a unique id attribute. This will be used to link the segment content to a segment button via the button's contentId property.
